\begin{table}[h]

\caption{Contamination probe: strict consensus diagnostic for recall of replication outcomes from a title + one-line locator for the specific finding (RPP/CB: effect description; SSRP: year plus the null-distribution family of the original test statistic, e.g.\ ``an F distribution''), $R{=}10$ queries per effect/claim at reasoning\_effort=high. A consensus recall requires at least 6/10 responses to jointly report familiarity=recognized and the same directional verdict (equivalently, a 10-run recognized-directional mean of at least 0.6). Consensus accuracy and the majority-class baseline use only consensus recalls; Chance $p$ is their two-sided exact binomial comparison. Formally, $n_R=\sum_i R_i$, $n_C=\sum_i C_i$, Consensus acc. $=n_C/n_R$, and $p_0=\max\{\sum_iR_iY_i,\sum_iR_i(1-Y_i)\}/n_R$. Chance $p$ is the two-sided exact test for $X\sim\mathrm{Binomial}(n_R,p_0)$ at $X=n_C$. No corpus's conditional claim accuracy exceeds its majority-class baseline at $\alpha$=.05 by the exact binomial test.}

\noindent In CB, main-pipeline accuracy rose from 18/34 (52.9\%) for $K_i=0$ to 90/124 (72.6\%) for $K_i\ge1$ and 38/47 (80.9\%) for $K_i\ge5$; Spearman $\rho=0.267$. Among the $K_i=0$ effects, the main pipeline still exceeded embedding LR (52.9\% versus 47.1\%, a 5.9 percentage-point difference), so its transfer advantage is not confined to effects with an elicited concordant recall, although it is markedly smaller in that stratum. Because $K_i=0$ means that this probe did not elicit a concordant recognized response, it is not proof that the model never encountered the study during pretraining.

\noindent For recognized directional response $r$ in unit $i$, let $V_{ir}=1$ for a replicable verdict and let $Y_i=1$ for a replicable observed outcome. We fit, separately by corpus,
\[ \mathrm{logit}\{\Pr(V_{ir}=1\mid Y_i)\}=\beta_0+\beta_1Y_i, \]
using a binomial GEE with unit-clustered, exchangeable working correlation. The table reports $\exp(\beta_1)$ and its robust Wald-test $p$-value; values repeat within a corpus because the model is fit across both observed-outcome rows.
